motion_v1.negotiation: Authenticate.motionProfileVersion=1.0.0; omitted means legacy shape; missing profile means authoritative-only fallback
motion_v1.geometry: exact validated C06 geometry_hash for baseline mapId/mapRevision
motion_v1.anchor: selfMotion.position is complete at selfMotion.serverTick=serverTick, even without self upsert
motion_v1.consumed_input_seq: inclusive monotonic queue removal, including expired and coalesced inputs; resets with stream
motion_v1.input_applied_ticks: actual model applications for ackInputSeq including neutral or blocked outcomes; resets on ACK change and stream
motion_v1.dropped_ticks: cumulative discarded due ticks within room epoch; preserved across stream replacement
motion_v1.hold: remainingHoldMs measured at serialized capture; age<=holdMs is inclusive; never infer original arrival clock
motion_v1.prediction: tentative bounded only; correct every anchor; no exact arrival replay or interaction/HTTP command replay
motion_v1.fallback: no negotiated profile or geometry mismatch means no local prediction
